description: Invite one person to the company workspace, or refresh their pending invitation (same address: role and teams are replaced). Requires an API key with the `people:invite` scope, held by an owner. role is one of operator, editor, viewer or filer; owner and board_viewer are never granted this way. email must be on a domain the company has verified. teamIds are existing organization teams (at most 20). notify defaults to true and sends the invitation email; pass false for a company whose people sign in with single sign-on. At most 200 invitations a day per key. Only call when the operator asked to invite this person with this role.

email.description: The invitee's email address, on a verified company domain.

role.description: The role they get when they join.

teamIds.description: Existing organization team ids to add them to.

name: anyforge_invite_person
title: Invite person
